termConditionComponent.heading: VALENS MASTER SUBSCRIPTOR POLICY
termConditionComponent.section1Body: This Master Subscription Policy applies to all users participating in the Valens subscription ecosystem, including Plan Owners and Subscribers. By activating or subscribing, users agree to this policy, including Valens Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and Payout Policy.
termConditionComponent.partATitle: PART A — TERMS FOR PLAN OWNERS
termConditionComponent.section2Body: When you activate a subscription plan, you become a Plan Owner. You may create private channels, define perks, and set monthly subscription prices between $9.99 USD and $100.00 USD.
termConditionComponent.section3Sub1Body: Valens charges $19.99 USD/month for hosting and operating your subscription channel.
termConditionComponent.section3Sub2Body: A 5% withdrawal fee applies to every payout request.
termConditionComponent.section3Sub3Body: By enabling your plan, you authorize Valens to charge maintenance fees and deduct payout withdrawal fees automatically.
termConditionComponent.section4Body: Earnings are visible in the Creator Dashboard. Payouts follow the Payout Policy. KYC verification is required. You must report earnings to tax authorities.
termConditionComponent.section5Body: All private content must follow Valens guidelines. Illegal, harmful, abusive, or fraudulent content is prohibited.
termConditionComponent.section6Body: Valens may restrict monetization, freeze payouts, remove content, or disable plans upon violations.
termConditionComponent.section7Body: Subscribers gain access to exclusive private content and perks. Access is non-transferable.
termConditionComponent.section8Body: By subscribing, you authorize Valens to bill you monthly until cancellation.
termConditionComponent.section9Body: You may cancel anytime. Access remains until the end of the billing period. No partial refunds.
termConditionComponent.section10Body: All subscription payments are final and non-refundable, including unused periods.
termConditionComponent.section11Body: Subscribers may NOT screenshot, record, download, print, or share subscription content. Violations may result in a security block.
termConditionComponent.section12Body: All interactions must comply with Valens Community Guidelines and legal requirements.
termConditionComponent.section13Body: Valens may update fees, freeze suspicious activity, restrict payouts, or suspend programs.
termConditionComponent.section14Body: By using subscription features, you agree to this policy and authorize Valens to manage charges and fees.
